<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **40** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d2bc1ffdc36412da08a7ff40350302b991aeef6f` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `523d7cb4a5f55dca632e69e5a6ff0268030a9df5` — the merge of head `d559e09a24d4784119d3ef080f1bfbc9bcc69203` into base `d2bc1ffdc36412da08a7ff40350302b991aeef6f`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 523d7cb4a5f55dca632e69e5a6ff0268030a9df5 && git checkout 523d7cb4a5f55dca632e69e5a6ff0268030a9df5
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin d2bc1ffdc36412da08a7ff40350302b991aeef6f d559e09a24d4784119d3ef080f1bfbc9bcc69203 && git checkout -B drift-repro d2bc1ffdc36412da08a7ff40350302b991aeef6f && git merge --no-ff d559e09a24d4784119d3ef080f1bfbc9bcc69203

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d2bc1ffdc36412da08a7ff40350302b991aeef6f
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs d2bc1ffdc36412da08a7ff40350302b991aeef6f` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：`os doctor` 只出警告时，只有当某条警告确实有「加 `--verbose` 才显示的修复建议」，结尾才提示「用 --verbose 查看修复建议」。缺测试文件、`@deprecated` 用法、循环依赖、未用对象、孤立视图这几类警告本来就没有修复建议，不再白白让人重跑。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是某次该提示时没提示，用户少看到一条建议。警告本身和退出码不变。
- 要你做什么：不需要你做任何事，区域自己落地。

The main merge (`d559e09a`, parents `1dc43d70` + `f981dce3`) has no combined hunk in `git diff-tree --cc`. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 35626`: NOT governed, 0 of 3 paths. `Fixes #35454`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `@objectstack/cli` patch.
- **The three-way classification holds. I read every `hasWarnings = true` site on this head (11 sites) against what each prints with and without `--verbose`.**
  - **Fix shown only under `--verbose`, so it sets `hasVerboseOnlyFix`:**
    - Environment `results` warnings with a `fix`. `renderHealthCheckResult` prints `fix` unasked only for an `error`.
    - Dashboard-widget warnings with a non-empty `hint`. The hint line is printed only under `flags.verbose`.
    - The config-load failure. `configLoadFailureCheck` returns `status: 'warning'` with a `fix`, and it goes through the same renderer.
    - Every `--scan-deprecations` hit. Its `replacement` is printed only under `--verbose`, and all eight `DEPRECATED_PATTERNS` rows carry a non-empty `replacement`, so the unconditional set is right.
  - **No fix in either mode, so it leaves the flag:** missing tests, `@deprecated` usages, circular dependencies, unused objects and orphan views. Each is a bare `printWarning` loop. These are the card's five.
  - **Fix already printed unasked, so it leaves the flag:**
    - The platform-protocol gap prints `→ ${protocolGap.hint}` right after its warning, outside any `verbose` test.
    - The isolated unique-scope block prints `→ ${GLOBAL_UNIQUE_ISOLATED_PRESCRIPTION}` once after its findings, also unconditionally.
    - A `--verbose` re-run adds nothing to either, so leaving the flag is right. This is the reading the area asked me to confirm.
- **Card's Done-when**
  - New pin: only a "Missing test" warning fires, and the summary tail does not name `--verbose`. It was red at `86ec0951` and green at `1dc43d70`.
  - The fix-bearing half is #35377's existing case, a warning with a fix that keeps the hint, and it stays green.

  - The CLI unit tier passes 6163/6163 on this head. Two families are NOT MEASURED (exit 3, no repo-wide dist) and are left to CI.
- nit (accepted): the "fix already printed" class has no pin of its own. A run where only the protocol gap fires would print no hint, by reading. That is the intended outcome, and the line is low-risk.
- **范围外去向** — an empty widget `hint` printing a bare `→` under `--verbose` is noted in the Acceptance notes, not filed. It is cosmetic and below p2. Nothing is owed.
